description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Mayo Clinic is a healthcare organization seeking a Software Engineer to develop and support Human Capital Management integrations for its Oracle Enterprise Resource Planning system. The role focuses on Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle HCM Fast Formulas, secure enterprise integrations, full software development lifecycle activities, troubleshooting, documentation, and production support, including participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation.
Enterprise integration engineer building HR cloud integrations, APIs, data transformations, and production support

Responsibilities:
• The Software Engineer will design, develop, implement, and support secure, reliable, and scalable integrations between Oracle HCM Cloud and internal applications, external vendors, APIs, databases, and other enterprise platforms
• Responsibilities include developing OIC integrations, orchestrations, mappings, transformations, connections, and error-handling processes, as well as Oracle HCM Fast Formulas and related integration components
• Works closely with Product Managers, Architects, functional teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions
• Develops and supports integrations using technologies such as REST and SOAP APIs, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, SFTP, JSON, XML, and other Oracle HCM integration capabilities
• Participates in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support
• Applies integration standards and DevOps practices to create solutions that are secure, reusable, maintainable, and resilient
• Supports CI/CD and deployment automation using tools such as Azure DevOps (ADO) and Azure Pipelines
• Performs troubleshooting and root cause analysis of integration and application issues using OIC monitoring, logs, payloads, and other diagnostic tools
• Ensures appropriate technical documentation is created and maintained and that solutions comply with organizational security, privacy, and data protection requirements
• Communicates effectively with technical and business partners across the organization and continues to build knowledge of Oracle HCM, OIC, enterprise integration patterns, organizational processes, and customers
• Participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation is required

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science/engineering or related field; or an associate's degree in computer science/engineering or related field with an additional 2 years of experience as described below
• Have working knowledge and experience of Software Engineering with a minimum of internships and a minimum of 1 yr. of experience, or 2yrs of experience coding applications or services in a high-level language (C, C++, Golang, Java, C# etc.)
• Demonstrated problem solving and time management skills
• Possesses strong technical aptitude for designing and implementing software solutions
• Experience with modern application development frameworks
• Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
• Deep hands-on technical expertise, excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Experience with Agile software development techniques
• Position requires a high level of analytical skill, ability to manage varied workload on projects, proactiveness, and excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Willing and capable of adapting to shifting requirements
• Experience writing and supporting complex database queries is highly valued
• This position will be expected to develop and support integration code using the following technologies: Oracle Fusion Cloud Platforms - Required
• This position will be expected to develop and support integration code using the following technologies: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) - Required
• This position will be expected to develop and support integration code using the following technologies: Oracle HCM Data Loader (HDL)
• This position will be expected to develop and support integration code using the following technologies: Oracle HCM Extracts
• This position will be expected to develop and support integration code using the following technologies: Oracle Business Intelligence Publisher (BIP)
• This position will be expected to develop and support integration code using the following technologies: Oracle File-Based Data Import (FBDI)
• This position will be expected to develop and support integration code using the following technologies: Oracle Web Services (SOAP/REST)
• This position will be expected to develop and support integration code using the following technologies: Oracle SQL – PL/SQL
• Authorization to work and remain in the United States, without necessity for Mayo Clinic sponsorships now, or in the future (for example, be a U.S. Citizen, national, or permanent resident, refugee, or asylee). Mayo Clinic does not participate in the F-1 STEM OPT extension program
• Schedule Details: Monday – Friday, 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m
• This is a hybrid position and must be located within 100 miles of a Mayo Clinic campus for occasional on-site expectations based on business needs
• Participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation is required
